# Data dictionary (Phase 2)

*Generated by `make dictionary` (`credit_risk.data.dictionary`); do not edit by hand. Machine-readable copy: `configs/data_dictionary.csv`. Leakage verdicts: `reports/leakage_table.md`.*

**How to read it.** Each column has a *group* (the business family it belongs to), a *kind* (what sort of value it holds, which decides how it is charted) and a *range*: the 1st to 99th percentile with the median, markers such as 365243 removed, and day counts shown as years before the application. *IV* is the information value against default on the training fold (main table only; the related tables enter the model through aggregated features, see `reports/feature_shapes.md`). *Special* is Kaggle's own note on the column.

## Kinds and how each is charted

| Kind | Unit | Columns | Chart |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| amount | currency units (not stated) | 29 | Histogram on a log scale, with default rate per bin |
| category | text levels | 35 | Bars per level sorted by default rate, with counts; rare levels grouped |
| count | count | 27 | Bar per value (large values capped), with default rate per value |
| days | days before the application | 17 | Histogram in years, with default rate per bin |
| flag | yes / no | 37 | Two bars: share of applicants and default rate for each value |
| key | identifier | 12 | Join coverage: share of applicants with rows |
| label | 1 = payment difficulty | 1 | Headline rate, then default rate by segment |
| months | months before the application | 3 | Histogram of history length |
| number | as recorded | 5 | Histogram, with default rate per bin |
| rating | ordinal level | 2 | Bar per level, with default rate |
| score | normalised, 0-1 | 50 | Histogram, with default rate per decile |
